COAD.description: Colon adenocarcinoma. encode_chromatin added 2026-09-03 (expanded-covariate-sources task, Objective A.4): adult primary colonic mucosa DNase-seq, filling the open-chromatin gap alongside the existing TCGA ATAC coverage (a matched-tissue, non-tumor complement to the TCGA-tumor ATAC signal).

BRCA.description: Breast invasive carcinoma. encode_chromatin added 2026-09-03 (expanded-covariate-sources task, Objective A.4): adult primary breast epithelium DNase-seq, filling the open-chromatin gap alongside the existing TCGA ATAC coverage.

UCEC.description: Uterine Corpus Endometrial Carcinoma. encode_chromatin added 2026-09-03 (expanded-covariate-sources task): ENCODE has adult primary uterus tissue for 5 of our 7 default marks plus DNase -- H3K4me1, H3K9me3, H3K36me3, H3K27ac, H3K27me3 and DNase (one of two available adult uterus DNase experiments used). Missing H3K4me3 and H3K9ac (not released for this biosample).

STAD.description: Stomach Adenocarcinoma. encode_chromatin added 2026-09-03 (expanded-covariate-sources task, Objective A.4): adult primary stomach tissue DNase-seq, filling the open-chromatin gap alongside the existing TCGA ATAC coverage.

TGCT.description: Testicular Germ Cell Tumors. encode_chromatin added 2026-09-03 (expanded-covariate-sources task): ENCODE has adult primary testis tissue for 6 of our 7 default marks plus DNase -- H3K4me1, H3K27ac, H3K27me3, H3K9me3, H3K36me3 and DNase all from the same 37yo donor; H3K4me3 only exists from a different (54yo) donor, used anyway since it's the only adult testis H3K4me3 available (a documented donor mismatch, not a tissue mismatch). Missing only H3K9ac.

OV.description: Ovarian Serous Cystadenocarcinoma. encode_chromatin added 2026-09-03 (expanded-covariate-sources task, Objective A.3): DNase-seq substituted for the missing TCGA ATAC-seq coverage (Corces et al. 2018 didn't profile ovarian cancer) -- adult primary ovary tissue DNase-seq exists natively on ENCODE (9 released adult experiments; one used here), unrelated to the ATAC gap since ATAC and DNase are separate assay catalogs.

SKCM.description: Skin Cutaneous Melanoma; GTEx representative column is sun-exposed skin (lower leg) since cutaneous melanoma is predominantly associated with sun-exposed body sites, not sun-shielded ones -- not-sun-exposed skin is also GTEx-mapped for the full covariate matrix. Roadmap eids are primary melanocyte cultures (E059, E061), matching melanoma's cell of origin rather than the broader skin fibroblast/keratinocyte epigenomes (E126/E127) also in the 127-panel. encode_chromatin (DNase) checked 2026-09-03 (Objective A.4) and NOT added: ENCODE's only melanocyte DNase-seq experiments are newborn foreskin or unspecified life stage (ENCSR518JGY, ENCSR434OBM, ENCSR000ELD) -- no adult sample exists, so left unfilled rather than using an age-mismatched proxy.

ACC.description: Adrenocortical Carcinoma. No adult adrenal/adrenocortical epigenome exists in Roadmap's 127-panel -- only E080 (Fetal Adrenal Gland), rejected as a tissue-stage mismatch, same rationale as UCEC/TGCT rejecting anatomically-close-but-wrong candidates. No adrenal/H295R cell line in ENCODE's ReplicationTimingSeries (22 series checked) or GEO GSE137764 (H1/H9/HCT116-only, confirmed). encode_chromatin added 2026-09-03 (expanded-covariate-sources task): ENCODE's own native-GRCh38 experiments cover adult primary adrenal gland tissue directly (a female, 41yo donor) for 5 of our 7 default marks plus DNase -- a source Roadmap's 127-panel never had. H3K9ac and H3K27ac have no released adult adrenal gland experiment on ENCODE (checked via the full organ_slims=adrenal+gland Histone ChIP-seq listing, not a per-mark miss); left unfilled rather than substituting a cell line.

BLCA.description: Bladder Urothelial Carcinoma. No bladder/urothelial/urinary anatomy category exists in Roadmap's standard 127-panel (checked the full EID_metadata.tab, not just a candidate shortlist). No bladder-derived cell line in ENCODE's ReplicationTimingSeries (28 series checked across both the UW 6-fraction and Gilbert wavelet cohorts) or GEO GSE137764 (H1/H9/HCT116-only, confirmed). encode_chromatin added 2026-09-03 (expanded-covariate-sources task): ENCODE has adult primary urinary bladder tissue (same male donor) for 4 of our 7 default marks -- H3K4me1, H3K27ac, H3K4me3, H3K36me3. Missing H3K9ac, H3K9me3, H3K27me3 (not released for this biosample). The only bladder DNase-seq experiment on ENCODE (ENCSR813CKU) is embryonic, not adult -- rejected as a tissue-stage mismatch, same rationale ACC/UCEC/TGCT already use for rejecting Roadmap's fetal-only candidates.

CESC.description: Cervical Squamous Cell Carcinoma and Endocervical Adenocarcinoma. GTEx representative column is Cervix_Ectocervix (squamous epithelium) since squamous carcinoma is the majority histology in this cohort. Roadmap's only cervix entry is E117 (HeLa-S3), a cervical cancer cell line rather than primary tissue -- same rationale as using K562 for LAML, the best available match when no normal-tissue epigenome exists for this anatomy. HeLa-S3 is also in ENCODE's UW 6-fraction Repli-seq cohort, so both roadmap and repliseq use the same cell line here. encode_chromatin (DNase) checked 2026-09-03 (Objective A.4) and NOT added: ENCODE has zero cervix/ectocervix/endocervix DNase-seq experiments at all (searchTerm queries for all three return no results) -- not just no adult match, no match of any kind.

CHOL.description: Cholangiocarcinoma. GTEx maps to Liver/Liver_Portal_Tract; Roadmap and repliseq both use liver-tissue/liver-cell-line sources (E066 primary liver, E118/HepG2 hepatocellular line) since no bile-duct-specific epigenome or cell line exists in either resource -- HepG2 is a hepatocyte line, not cholangiocyte, so this is the best available organ-level proxy rather than a cell-type match, same caveat pattern as CESC's HeLa-S3 use. HepG2 is also in ENCODE's UW 6-fraction Repli-seq cohort (same assay family as MCF-7/HeLa-S3), all 6 fractions present. encode_chromatin added 2026-09-03 (expanded-covariate-sources task, Objective A.4): adult primary liver tissue DNase-seq (not HepG2 -- same organ-level-proxy caveat as the marks/repliseq above, but a real tissue sample rather than a cell line where one exists for this assay).

DLBC.description: Diffuse large B-cell lymphoma. GTEx maps to Whole_Blood/Spleen (no lymph-node column in GTEx). No TCGA ATAC-seq coverage (atac: null). Roadmap uses E032 (primary B cells from peripheral blood, the direct cell-of-origin match, 6/7 marks -- H3K9ac 404s) plus E062 (primary PBMCs, broader immune mix, 7/7 marks) for fuller coverage, same two-epigenome pattern as CHOL/CESC. Repliseq uses GM12878 (EBV-transformed lymphoblastoid B-cell line), the standard ENCODE UW 6-fraction Repli-seq series, hg19, all 6 fractions live-verified -- the closest available cell-type match for a B-cell malignancy, analogous to CHOL's HepG2/BRCA's MCF-7 choices. encode_chromatin added 2026-09-03 (expanded-covariate-sources task, Objective A.3): DNase-seq substituted for the missing TCGA ATAC-seq coverage, same rationale as OV -- adult primary peripheral-blood B cell DNase-seq exists natively on ENCODE (8 released adult experiments; one used here), matching E032's cell-of-origin choice.

ESCA.description: Esophageal Carcinoma. GTEx maps to Esophagus_Mucosa/Esophagus_Muscularis/Esophagus_Gastroesophageal_Junction; representative column is Mucosa (the epithelial layer, tumor cell-of-origin). Note the cohort itself mixes two genomically distinct histologies (squamous cell carcinoma and adenocarcinoma, the latter overlapping gastric/GEJ biology) -- a caveat for interpreting results, not something the covariate matrix can resolve. TCGA ATAC-seq covered (1 UUID, live-verified via GDC /data GET -- /files metadata 404s for this UUID the same way it does for CHOL's, a known GDC quirk, not a bad UUID). Roadmap uses E079 (Esophagus, the direct organ match, 6/7 marks -- H3K9ac 404s). No esophageal, gastric, or GI-tract cell line exists in ENCODE's Repli-seq experiment set or GEO GSE137764's MAT set (H1/H9/HCT116 only) -- repliseq is null, same as OV. encode_chromatin added 2026-09-03 (expanded-covariate-sources task, Objective A.4): adult primary esophagus (squamous epithelium) DNase-seq, filling the open-chromatin gap alongside the existing TCGA ATAC coverage.

GENERIC.description: Tissue-agnostic pan-tissue covariate pool, not a TCGA study code -- see sigmutselcovs' DEVELOPMENT.md, 'Generic (pan-tissue) covariates'. Objective B of the expanded-covariate-sources task (2026-09-03). gtex.reduce='median' collapses all 68 GTEx tissue columns into one gtex_pantissue_median column instead of picking one representative tissue. roadmap.eids is 14 Roadmap epigenomes, all with full 7-mark or near-full coverage (E003, E017, E027, E028, E029, E032, E037, E050, E059, E061, E062, E066, E071, E075) -- most already used across other cohorts' own rows, plus E003/E017/E029/E037/E050/E071 added for spread. **Trimmed down from an original 26-EID plan (2026-09-04)**: gauss's disk filled to 45G free mid-download (44G already used just by the first 14 EIDs, on a machine at 98% overall usage from other data, not only this task's) -- rather than delete other people's/other tasks' data to make room, the pool was capped at what had already downloaded cleanly and the remaining 12 planned EIDs (E079 partial -- deleted -- plus E087/E094/E097/E101/E102/E106/E110/E112/E117/E118/E119, never started) were dropped. 14 epigenomes is still far more than any single cohort's 0-4, and Objective C's numerosity sweep is where a larger N should be tested deliberately (with disk budgeted up front), not this permanent registry entry. encode_chromatin.tracks reuses the 10 DNase accessions already found for ACC/TGCT/UCEC/OV/DLBC/COAD/BRCA/STAD/CHOL/ESCA (zero new downloads, real tissue diversity for free). The 3 marks Roadmap's default panel and our per-cohort rows lack (H3K23ac, H3K14ac, H2AK9ac) were deliberately NOT added here after checking: ENCODE's only H3K23ac/H3K14ac experiments are on in-vitro-differentiated stem cells (not real tissue), and its one H2AK9ac experiment (IMR-90) carries quality-control flags (36bp reads, NRF=0.43) -- same 'don't substitute a bad proxy' principle used throughout this registry, not a search gap.
